other_conditions: The industrial unit must have availed a term loan for the project.
Commercial production must commence before applying for subsidy disbursement.
Application for subsidy must be made within one year from the Date of Commercial Production (DoCP).
The total subsidy received (State + Central) must not exceed the total term loan amount disbursed.

Eligible activities include Activity 1: Garments, Apparel & Made‑ups, Technical Textiles (including Composite Unit) and Activity 2: Weaving (with or without preparatory), Knitting, Dyeing & Processing, Texturising, Twisting, Embroidery and MMF Spinning to manufacture yarn from Polyester Staple Fiber (PSF) / Viscose Staple Fiber (VSF) (excluding cotton and synthetic filament yarn).
benefits_summary: Provides a capital subsidy of up to 35% of eligible fixed capital investment for Category 1 units (maximum ₹100 crore) and up to 20% for Category 3 units, with rates varying by activity and taluka category.
